channel.title: United Kingdom — Register of licensed student sponsors: recorded changes
channel.description: Dated changes recorded against the Register of licensed student sponsors, published by UK Home Office. A row appearing or disappearing is not evidence of wrongdoing.

item.title: No longer listed: British Academy of Jewellery
item.description: No longer listed on the register of licensed student sponsors published 2026-08-26. It appeared on the edition published 2026-08-25. A row disappearing from a register is not by itself evidence of wrongdoing. It can mean the institution's approval was withdrawn, but it can equally mean a voluntary surrender, a merger, a rename, a corporate restructure, a lapse at renewal, or a correction by the publisher. The source publishes a status, not a cause, and we cannot tell which applies.
